items.title: @ishanskhare：Excited to announce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM): our new paradigm for fast and parallel, coarse-to-fine text generation.
items.abstract_or_text: Excited to announce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM): our new paradigm for fast and parallel, coarse-to-fine text generation. Compared to strong diffusion language models at similar parameter sizes, NCM showcases 31x faster generation on summarization and translation, and 10-21x faster unconditional generation with comparable or better generative perplexity using 3-5x fewer training tokens.

items.title: @omarsar0：Banger paper from Stanford, Together AI, and colleagues. This paper proposes Hybrid Reasoning Agents, which reason inter
items.abstract_or_text: Banger paper from Stanford, Together AI, and colleagues. This paper proposes Hybrid Reasoning Agents, which reason internally in latent space and switch to text only to call a tool or give an answer. Across 11 benchmarks it outperforms frontier LLM agents by 10.4% on average, uses 35.5% to 54.7% fewer tokens, and runs 1.8x to 2.6x faster.

items.title: @AnthropicAI：Working out how best to use AI in mathematics research—and in science more generally—will take time, effort, and resourc
items.abstract_or_text: Working out how best to use AI in mathematics research—and in science more generally—will take time, effort, and resources. We're eager to support mathematicians as they drive scientific progress and define the future of their field. We've committed 5 million of funding, compute, and Claude access to help the math community navigate the massive changes that AI brings. We're partnering with @SimonsFdn, who will manage the award through a community-driven approach, supporting workshops, conferences, and lectures by domain experts.

items.title: @OpenAI：We want to support the mathematics community in turning progress in AI into deeper human understanding and new discoveri
items.abstract_or_text: We want to support the mathematics community in turning progress in AI into deeper human understanding and new discoveries. To support that goal, we are contributing 5 million to a new Simons Foundation initiative to help mathematicians examine, understand, and build on results produced by AI, including the results we recently published. The funding, managed and awarded by the @SimonsFdn will support workshops, conferences, and special programs. We will also provide access to our models and computing resources to Simons Foundation-supported researchers.

items.title: @AIatMeta：We're exploring how AI can accelerate health science research. We built a human-led research scaffold powered by Muse Sp
items.abstract_or_text: We're exploring how AI can accelerate health science research. We built a human-led research scaffold powered by Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder with access to 5M retrospective de-identified electronic health records. A cohort of medical experts used the system to conduct original research while maintaining full authority over scientific decisions. Today, we're sharing 10 research manuscripts produced through this exploration, spanning cardiology, oncology, infectious disease, emergency medicine, and more.
